text: Agent Swarm 是面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端的多智能体协作插件。它把持久化任务运行时接入 Harness，提供自然语言启动命令、协调工具和原生会话侧栏。团队可拆分工作、共享发现、提交成果并由其他成员独立验证；用户能查看活动、任务进展和已验收交付，再决定是否应用结果。适合希望让多个智能体协作处理本地 Git 项目，并追踪审查与交付过程的用户。运行需要兼容版本的 Harness、Node.js、Git 和本地 Git 项目；模型凭据由宿主管理。

Agent Swarm coordinates multi-agent work in DeepSeek Harness. A slash command starts planning and collaboration with independent review; the conversation sidebar shows activity and accepted deliveries. Requires compatible Harness, Node.js, and Git; model credentials come from the host.

让 DSH 根据我的自然语言目标组织协作团队。
怎样查看成员做了什么以及哪些成果已经验收？
我希望把复杂开发拆成可并行、可复核的任务。
I want several AI agents to coordinate on a Git project and review each other's work.
How can I track agent tasks, activity, and accepted deliverables in my Harness conversation?
Agent Swarm 的功能「自然语言启动协作」：在 Harness 会话输入 `/agent-swarm` 和目标描述，命令将请求交给运行时规划团队并启动任务。
Agent Swarm 的功能「协调与独立复核」：主 agent 可创建任务、分配成员并设置验收条件；成员提交成果后，由独立验证流程检查并记录结论。
Agent Swarm 的功能「会话侧栏进展面板」：在原生右侧栏查看 swarm 活动、成员历史和交付状态，并打开成员会话或查看已验收成果。

@dsh-external/dsh-agent-swarm README · Know what is happening：- **Recognizable members.** Host-assigned names and stable robot portraits make each member recognizable; responsibilities stay in a separate role field. Explicit custom names remain supported. Open a member's conversation to inspect its work.

- **Progress backed by events.** Tool results, submissions and acceptance events appear in the feed. Resource usage stays in details instead of masquerading as a completion percentage.

@dsh-external/dsh-agent-swarm README · Know what is happening：The UI follows host state without making model requests to render updates. Operation activity is a liveness signal, not a guarantee that useful work has finished.

@dsh-external/dsh-agent-swarm README · Keep momentum through interruptions：A long task needs more than a launch button. Agent Swarm keeps assignments, evidence, decisions and recovery state on disk so the team can continue through supported interruption and restart paths.

@dsh-external/dsh-agent-swarm README · Keep momentum through interruptions：**Repair without losing the task's purpose.** When an independent review rejects a task, the primary reworks it in place: `swarm_control` with `action: "resume"` re-opens the rejected task for its author, who stays pinned to it and resumes from the rejected commit, and re-opens the review that rejected it with the same reviewer, so the resubmission is reviewed at once without a new review task. A task can be reworked `maxRework` times (default 2; raise it in `swarm_control` `changes`); after that, a replacement proposed with `replaces` answers for every criterion of the task it replaces, the mission criteria it covers included, without copying them; downstream dependencies follow the accepted repair, and accepting it retires the whole chain it replaced. The rejected commit, the rejection reason and the claims of that round stay on the task and its review as archived history: they cannot be challenged again and never block completion. A challenge disputes only a claim a verdict can still judge: a claim the rejection refuted (before the rework too), one a verified claim superseded, one of cancelled work and a

@dsh-external/dsh-agent-swarm README · Keep momentum through interruptions：**Bring decisions back to the primary agent.** Rejections, blocked work, provider problems and exhausted limits can generate durable notices. The primary agent can revise the plan, arrange a repair or adjust a budget with a recorded reason. Ordinary recovery decisions do not require you to configure the swarm again.

@dsh-external/dsh-agent-swarm README · Keep momentum through interruptions：**Completion keeps its meaning.** Unfinished synthesis and review tasks stay on the board and bring the primary back to repair them. An empty runnable queue cannot silently cancel required work or mark the mission complete.

@dsh-external/dsh-agent-swarm README · Keep momentum through interruptions：**Keep resource use visible.** The primary agent chooses team size, task limits, step and token budgets, recovery allowances and verification timeouts. Usage is tracked across the team, with cache and output breakdowns and the primary conversation's usage shown separately. Resuming does not reset consumption. If a native worker session must be recreated, a durable accounting generation keeps new usage separate from the old watermark while preserving lifetime totals.

@dsh-external/dsh-agent-swarm README · Keep momentum through interruptions：Recovery runs within the mission's limits. Notifications remain queued while the primary agent is offline, and a stuck native model call may delay when it can process them. Provider-reported usage and estimates for requests still in flight can also allow a budget overshoot.

@dsh-external/dsh-agent-swarm README · Architecture：**The primary agent chooses the direction. The runtime coordinates the work. Harness runs the agents.**

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    G["Your goal"] --> P["Primary agent · plan, team and budgets"]
    P -->|Plan and decisions| R["Swarm runtime · durable coordination"]
    R -->|Decision notices| P

@dsh-external/dsh-agent-swarm README · Architecture：**Freedom inside a clear contract.** Workers share evidence and propose further work; the runtime checks scope, dependencies and review requirements. Peer messages cannot expand permissions, raise budgets or waive independent review.

@dsh-external/dsh-agent-swarm README · Architecture：**Recovery is part of coordination.** Durable state links each task to its attempt, artifact and decisions. When an attempt is interrupted, the runtime fences stale writes and uses the supported checkpoint, retry or reassignment path. Cases that need judgment return to the primary agent. Accepted replacements become the prerequisites for downstream work.

@dsh-external/dsh-agent-swarm README · Architecture：**Native execution, one visible mission.** Harness supplies model execution, sessions, the inbox, tools and sandboxing. The plugin owns mission coordination and verification policy; the sidebar projects mission state and observed activity. Collaboration messages use the native inbox and session log, while coordination records live in SQLite. No Harness core fork is required.

For the implementation contracts and their origins, see [design notes](docs/design.md).

@dsh-external/dsh-agent-swarm README · Get started：For bundle installation, upgrades, startup recovery and configuration, see the [operations guide](docs/operations.md).

@dsh-external/dsh-agent-swarm README · Get started：The tests come in two tiers. In a fresh clone, `npm ci && npm test` runs the hermetic tier, which needs no Harness checkout: `package-lock.json` pins every package it uses, the 0.2.1-rc.2 Harness packages from npm included. A fresh clone has no `node_modules` above it, and the hermetic tier and `npm run verify` refuse a checkout that has one, since packages there would stand in for what `npm ci` did not install. The host tier and most other suites also need the built checkout, linked with `npm run link:dsh` after `npm ci`. `npm run verify` runs every suite of the gate manifest (the `gate` block of `package.json`) whose prerequisites the machine has, and records the others as skipped with the reason. The hosted CI runs it from a fresh clone on macOS, so CI covers only the suites that need no checkout, sandbox or browser; see [development and verification](docs/operations.md#development-and-verification).

@dsh-external/dsh-agent-swarm README · Scope and practical limits：- **Local execution.** Distributed workers, non-Git projects and Windows execution are not supported. Separate hosts need separate state directories, which separate Harness homes give them by the plugin's one [root rule](docs/operations.md#storage-roots); concurrent recovery of the same database is unsupported. Up to `ba9a758`, a root the composed plugin row did not configure stayed in `~/.dsh/agent-swarm` whatever `DSH_HOME` or `DSH_AGENT_SWARM_ROOT` said: always on the direct mount, and on the bundle mount when a later layer replaced the row's config without both roots. Such an install that ran with another `DSH_HOME` or with `DSH_AGENT_SWARM_ROOT` set opens a new, empty store after the upgrade, and nothing on a stock profile says so; nothing adopts the old store, and the [storage roots](docs/operations.md#storage-roots) notes give the step that keeps it. Retained worktrees and artifact refs need explicit cleanup; verification checkouts a crash left behind are reclaimed by the mission's next verification that runs declared checks; a registration git left locked before recording its path must be removed by hand.

@dsh-external/dsh-agent-swarm README · 适合交给团队的工作：| 你的目标 | 团队如何协作 |
| --- | --- |
| 修复难以定位的问题 | 调查原因、实现修复，再由其他成员检查边界情况。 |
| 完成横跨多个模块的功能 | 拆分可以并行的工作，协调依赖，整合经过复核的成果。 |
| 理解陌生代码 | 收集证据、对照不同发现，并按要求提供不修改代码的分析。 |

**你描述结果，主 agent 组织协作。** 每次启动无需填写成员人数或 token 预算。成员可以在任务范围内交换发现、相互询问、质疑证据，并交接阶段成果。

@dsh-external/dsh-agent-swarm README · 从一句需求，到项目中的改进：1. **从项目现状出发。** 规划前先创建私有 Git 快照，包含已跟踪文件的改动和未被忽略的新文件。无需手动 commit，快照过程保留你的分支、暂存区和工作文件。
2. **让成员协同推进。** 主 agent 按可独立验收的结果和真实前置条件拆解工作。偏好成员忙碌时，满足执行条件的空闲成员可以接取尚未开始的待办；明确绑定和在途任务仍受保护。成员使用原生 Harness 会话与独立 Git worktree。
3. **复核实际提交的成果。** 由其他成员审查提交内容。对于代码任务，Harness 还会在准确的提交版本上执行声明的检查。没有检查的报告由复核人判断是否验收，这一判断须以复核人在复核中发布的至少一条声明为依据；每次验收都会记录它依据的检查或声明。
4. **就绪后再带回项目。** 任务完成后，侧栏为最终已验收的代码成果提供“查看修改”和“应用结果”。应用以初始快照为基准，保留你的分支和暂存区，不会自动暂存、提交或推送。

你原有的编辑属于任务基线，不会被算成 swarm 新增成果。检测到合并冲突时，会先报告，再由你处理。

@dsh-external/dsh-agent-swarm README · 中断之后，仍有继续推进的路径：**返工保留原来的任务目标。** 任务被独立复核驳回后，主 agent 可以在原任务上返工：`swarm_control` 的 `action: "resume"` 会把被驳回的任务重新交给原作者（作者保持固定，从被驳回的 commit 继续修改），并以同一位复核人重新打开作出驳回的复核，因此重新提交后立即复核，不会新增复核任务。每个任务最多返工 `maxRework` 次（默认 2 次，可在 `swarm_control` 的 `changes` 中提高）；超出后，用 `replaces` 提出的替代任务对原任务须满足的全部验收条件负责，包括原任务在 `covers` 中引用的条件，且无需复制；下游依赖跟随已验收的修复，替代任务被验收时会退役它所替代的整条链。被驳回的 commit、驳回理由和该轮的声明作为归档历史保留在任务及其复核上：不能再次质疑，也不会阻止完成。质疑只针对仍能由裁决判定的声明：被驳回推翻的声明（返工之前同样如此）、被已验证声明取代的声明、已取消任务的声明以及复核自身的证据，都会以 `[evidence_not_judgeable]` 拒绝，并指出争议还能提交到哪里（改为质疑某条仍有效的声明、由主 agent 返工或替代，或用 `swarm_escalate` 上报主 agent），因此这类质疑不会再取消驳回任务的那次复核，也不会重新打开已验收的工作。主 agent 还可以在原任务上修订执行额度和未提交工作的计划，按新版本修复启动失败的保存计划，并在不改变工件的情况下为已提交工作追加检查。
section: 中断之后，仍有继续推进的路径

text: @dsh-external/dsh-agent-swarm README · 中断之后，仍有继续推进的路径：**需要判断时，交回主 agent。** 审查驳回、工作受阻、供应商异常或预算耗尽等情况可以产生持久通知。主 agent 能调整计划、安排修复，或附带原因修改预算。常规恢复决策无需你重新配置团队。 **完成必须有依据。** 尚未完成的合成和复核会留在任务板上，并通知主 agent 修复。没有可运行任务，不会触发静默撤回必要工作或宣布完成。 **资源使用始终可查。** 主 agent 决定团队规模、任务上限、步数与 token 预算、恢复次数和验证超时。用量按团队记录，展示缓存和输出等明细，并单独列出主会话用量。继续任务不会重置已消耗的资源。原生 worker 会话需要重建时，持久化的会话计量代次会区分新旧水位，保留历史累计并继续记录新增用量。 恢复受任务预算与期限约束。主 agent 离线时通知会排队；卡住的原生模型调用也可能延迟消息处理。供应商用量上报和在途请求的估算，仍可能使实际用量超过预算。
section: 中断之后，仍有继续推进的路径

text:
@dsh-external/dsh-agent-swarm README · 产品架构：**主 agent 决定方向，运行时协调工作，Harness 执行智能体。**

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    G["你的目标"] --> P["主 agent · 计划、成员与预算"]
    P -->|计划与决策| R["Swarm 运行时 · 持久化协调"]
    R -->|需要决策的通知| P

**明确规则之内，保留协作自由。** 成员可以共享证据、提出后续工作；运行时检查范围、依赖和复核要求。成员之间的消息不能扩大权限、提高预算或豁免独立审查。

**恢复属于协调过程。** 持久状态把任务与执行实例、成果、决策关联起来。执行中断后，运行时拒绝旧实例继续写入，并通过支持的检查点、重试或重新分配路径恢复。需要判断的情况交回主 agent；已验收的替代成果成为下游任务的新前置条件。

**原生执行，统一呈现。** Harness 提供模型执行、会话、收件箱、工具和沙箱。插件负责协作与验收规则，侧栏展示任务状态和观察到的活动。协作消息进入原生收件箱与会话记录，协调数据保存在 SQLite 中，无需修改或 fork Harness 核心。
@dsh-external/dsh-agent-swarm README · 产品架构：实现约定与设计来源见[设计说明](docs/design.md)。

@dsh-external/dsh-agent-swarm README · 开始使用：```sh
git clone https://github.com/TT-Wang/dsh-agent-swarm.git
cd dsh-agent-swarm
export DSH_HARNESS_ROOT="/absolute/path/to/deepseek-harness"
npm run link:dsh

从准备开展任务的项目目录启动 Harness：

```sh
cd /absolute/path/to/your-project
node "$DSH_HARNESS_ROOT/apps/cli/lib/bin.js" --profile web
```

打开 Harness 输出的已认证启动链接，在会话中选择模型，输入 `/agent-swarm` 加上自然语言目标即可。该命令已注册到原生命令补全中。

@dsh-external/dsh-agent-swarm README · 开始使用：Agent Swarm 位于原生右侧栏，默认折叠。发送 `/agent-swarm` 加自然语言目标后会自动展开；也可以随时点击左侧导航底部的 Agent Swarm 按钮重新打开。右侧栏属于单个会话：打开某个成员的会话后，用同一个按钮打开它的只读协作视图。界面支持中英文和深浅主题。

Bundle 安装、升级、启动恢复与配置详见[使用与运维指南](docs/operations.zh-CN.md)。

@dsh-external/dsh-agent-swarm README · 开始使用：测试分为两层。在全新克隆中运行 `npm ci && npm test` 即执行封闭层，不需要 Harness 检出：`package-lock.json` 锁定了它用到的每个包，包括来自 npm 的 0.2.1-rc.2 Harness 包。全新克隆的上层目录没有 `node_modules`；若检出之上有，封闭层和 `npm run verify` 都会拒绝运行，因为那里的包会顶替 `npm ci` 没有安装的包。宿主层和其他大多数套件还需要已构建的检出，在 `npm ci` 之后用 `npm run link:dsh` 链接。`npm run verify` 运行 gate 清单（`package.json` 的 `gate` 块）中前提条件在本机齐全的每个套件，其余套件记为跳过并注明原因。托管 CI 在 macOS 上从全新克隆运行它，因此 CI 只覆盖不需要检出、沙箱或浏览器的套件；见[开发与验证](docs/operations.zh-CN.md#development-and-verification)。
@dsh-external/dsh-agent-swarm README · 适用范围与实际边界：详细约束与剩余风险见[已知限制](docs/known-limitations.md)，集成验证依据见[验证记录](docs/validation.md)。使用脚本化模型响应的测试不能当作模型质量或速度基准。

Agent Swarm 可以与 [dsh-slice-agent-loop](https://github.com/TT-Wang/dsh-slice-agent-loop) 配合管理会话上下文：Swarm 协调成员之间的工作，slice 策略管理每个会话内的历史。详见[组合使用说明](docs/operations.zh-CN.md#companion-context-policy)。
